mapper.select: SELECT access_grant.subject_id, access_grant.permission_version, permission.permission_code FROM organization_access.platform_access_grant access_grant INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = access_grant.subject_id INNER JOIN organization_access.platform_access_permission permission ON permission.subject_id = access_grant.subject_id WHERE access_grant.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND access_grant.status = 'ENABLED' AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE'
